symptom: Running unchanged `describe user role` output (create or modify user role) rewrites Security$ProjectSecurity: /UserRoles[0] marker 2 -> 3; same for DemoUsers on a demo-user rewrite
cause: The encoder's default PartList marker is 3; Studio Pro writes 2 for ProjectSecurity.UserRoles and .DemoUsers (PedApp, TestApp, expr-checker agree). An untouched list passes through raw, so it only shows once an element in it is rewritten
insight: A marker bug hides until the first rewrite of an element in that list; census the stored marker per (owner $Type, key) across Studio Pro fixtures and register it with RegisterPropertyListMarker
